fields.title: Venting is a conditional load reduction, not a qualified operation
fields.finding: The 0.458903732 pressure fraction and 2645.660029 kg use the 500 m full-volume state. At sea-level ISA the same absolute differential requires 2912.791114 kg on that convention. Venting an airborne neutral hull makes it descend; it needs a supported landing/handling sequence. Regulatory speeds are analogous test criteria, not established safe hull speeds.
fields.proposed_fix: Retain the arithmetic and require explicit terrain, support, gas volume, atmosphere and valve control. Do not infer a 500 m AGL operating condition solely from a 500 m atmospheric design altitude.

fields.title: Unstated modeling choices and material transfers
fields.finding: Exact reproduction needs SiC nu=0.16, core E/G scaled linearly with density in pricing, radial/planar nodal loading, a rounded 48.894 kg gas item, and an integral of the expanding hard-impact footprint. The artificial growth law, typical core crush and transferred shell/film properties remain unvalidated.
fields.proposed_fix: Pin these input conventions and their PROJECTION tags. Keep primary measured properties distinct from transferred allowables and from predictions of installed damage tolerance.

fields.claim: The dent-growth criterion is this seat's derivation: the face's fixed membrane force pR/4 on a paraboloid dent's curvature, against the core's crush strength less its share of the pressure, with the patch's plate buckling force taken off. No opened page prints it. Castanie, the CAI literature on face wrinkling over crushed core, and McGowan and Ambur's preload threshold support the mechanism, not the numbers.
fields.needed_to_ground: Compression-after-impact tests on beryllium-faced CR-III coupons at 300 MPa, dented at 0.25-2 mm over 30-100 mm.

fields.claim: The lost-core patch is read clamped (54.8 mm) and simply supported (27.1 mm); the real edge, a face continuous over intact core, lies between. The pressure that holds the face on the crushed core is a barrier this static reading ignores.
fields.needed_to_ground: A plate-on-crushable-foundation analysis of the dented patch, or the coupon test above.

fields.claim: The dent model (face membrane plus core crush over a plastic spread) is this seat's. It reads Pach's test within its 1.1-1.2 mm and 30 mm, and Clarke's FE at about half the FE depth. Hail is read three ways (fluid, Shi-calibrated, all energy) that span ten times in depth.
fields.needed_to_ground: Ice-ball tests on a beryllium-faced CR-III panel at 25-75 mm and IEC velocities.

fields.claim: No impact, puncture or through-thickness ductility data exist for thin SR-200 sheet. NASA 1971 calls beryllium's impact resistance extremely low. A cracked outer face vents its core cells; whether the CR-III core is perforated (034's evacuation of every cell) decides whether a crack vents the whole core.
fields.needed_to_ground: Drop and ice-ball tests on 0.8 mm SR-200 sheet over honeycomb, and the core venting design.

fields.claim: Each dent is scored alone against gamma 0.564; the as-built imperfection already spends that allowance, so a dent and the as-built shape compete for it.
fields.needed_to_ground: 015's map with two interacting imperfections, or a measured shell.

fields.claim: No hail flux (stones per square metre per storm, by size) was sourced, so the number of tube strikes in a storm is not given.
fields.needed_to_ground: A hail climatology for the site.

fields.claim: The tube's hail stress uses a shallow-shell-on-foundation reading of a cylinder, a static contact pressure (fluid or Shi-calibrated), no dynamic amplification, and the 14 mm Hexoloy tube data without size scaling. Birds, timber debris and tool drops on the tubes are not scored. No SiC tube impact test was found.
fields.needed_to_ground: Ice-ball tests on a 275 mm, 1.14 mm-wall SiC tube.

fields.claim: No Zylon/PBO film exists as a sourced product: no modulus, toughness, puncture or tear data. The tear lengths use other films' toughness and a projected modulus. The film is also unprotected from daylight (35 percent strength after six months).
fields.needed_to_ground: A built 0/90 PBO film with barrier, tested for puncture, slit tear under biaxial load and UV.

fields.claim: The lost-member screen is linear, rigid-jointed, on f4/f5 geodesics not at 022d's spacing, with lumped pressure loads; joint stiffness is unknown and no nonlinear collapse was run. 026b's discrete model is the place to repeat it.
fields.needed_to_ground: A nonlinear frame analysis with one member removed, on 026b's model with the real joint stiffness.

fields.claim: The film over the two bays a lost member leaves is scored at the same rise-to-span, a tension 1.5 times higher; the real film shape after loss is not modelled.
fields.needed_to_ground: A membrane analysis of the rhombic bay.

fields.claim: The descent model is a rigid sphere in ISA with an isothermal fill, a constant drag coefficient 0.2-0.47, added mass 0.5 rho V and no wind; the neutral-buoyancy pressure result assumes the inside air takes the outside temperature.
fields.needed_to_ground: A coupled thermal and trajectory model, and the site's atmosphere.

fields.claim: At a hole the face reads twice its membrane stress and yields out to 3.9 hole radii; whether the edge crumples and the hole grows while the slow leak keeps the load on is not modelled.
fields.needed_to_ground: A hole-edge analysis of the sandwich at 300 MPa, or a punctured coupon under biaxial compression.

fields.claim: No mast contact speed was sourced; TAR 473 and 14 CFR 25.473 stand in, and the 0.5 m contact patch is assumed.
fields.needed_to_ground: A mooring system design and its contact envelope.

fields.claim: 14 CFR 101.13 limits moored balloons to 152.4 m above the surface, below the 500 m design point; 101.19 requires a rapid-deflation device, which for a vacuum hull is a rapid air valve that lands it heavy.
fields.needed_to_ground: A regulatory route for a 500 m moored or free vacuum hull.

fields.claim: No inspection limit was sourced for beryllium faces, SiC tubes or PBO film; the tap-test PoD is for 0.5 mm aluminium and falls with face thickness. Access to a 1257 m2 hull at 500 m is not addressed.
fields.needed_to_ground: PoD trials on beryllium-faced coupons and an inspection-robot concept.

fields.claim: Bird and hail readings disagree by reading: a moored 4 lb bird is stable on the fluid pressure and grows on the all-energy reading.
fields.needed_to_ground: Soft-body impact analysis on the sandwich.

fields.title: Full-member compression distribution
fields.finding: 3.9 GPa is typical catalog compression, not a fitted scale at a known reference size. The 1 GPa baseline is only a ranking target.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure the actual full-length/full-wall production tube population in compression, including finish, joints and proof history.

fields.title: Linear frame and local shell interaction
fields.finding: Constant-g/R scaling retains checked linear fields. The 0.2 eigen knockdown and local peak substitution do not qualify imperfections or nonlinear collapse.
fields.proposed_fix: Validate joints, geometric imperfections and coupled local/global behavior for the final resized sections.

fields.title: Rigid joints
fields.finding: Sleeve sizing does not demonstrate rotational stiffness, peel, torsion, fatigue or temperature-dependent bond behavior.
fields.proposed_fix: Demonstrate the assembled joint stiffness and multiaxial load envelope at the actual installation.

fields.title: PBO effective ply strength
fields.finding: The 10 m least root requires about 5.343 GPa effective ply strength; 60% of yarn strength does not close this radius even with the other endpoints.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure biaxial crossply strength, construction efficiency, seams, attachments and sustained load.

fields.title: Ten-year retention
fields.finding: Warehouse extrapolation and .995/year protection target are not measured installed life. OD4 and white mass do not establish a durable coating.
fields.proposed_fix: Qualify combined light, humidity, stress, temperature, abrasion, fatigue and repair histories.

fields.title: Humidity criterion and service
fields.finding: 5% of cold saturation is a design target; h=2 shortens the nominal first interval. Initial fill is assumed dry.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure the complete internal dewpoint distribution and establish an operating interval including uncertainty.

fields.title: Barrier leakage and conditioning
fields.finding: OD3 coupon gas/WVTR and old outgassing inventories are transferred to installed OD4; 90% removal is assumed demonstrated.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure whole-hull leak acceptance, installed WVTR and a compatible conditioning endpoint.

fields.title: Onboard pumping and energy
fields.finding: 15–148 pump units arise from constant nominal-speed and 1000 W planning assumptions; this is not optimized or qualified hardware.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain installed wet-speed curves near 32.5 Pa and a complete power/heat/plumbing design; recalculate changed barrier and power architectures explicitly.

fields.title: Load introduction and wind
fields.finding: Uniform pressure envelope and a P2-sized pad mass do not establish P3 attachment strength or nonuniform wind loading.
fields.proposed_fix: Resolve full wind, gust, mooring, payload, cable and landing load paths on the discrete frame.

fields.title: Damage tolerance
fields.finding: 045 reports cascading member loss and running tears in predecessor configurations. No damage-tolerance repair is qualified or silently assigned zero cost here.
fields.proposed_fix: Demonstrate residual strength, tear arrest, impact resistance and realistic protection/inspection; carry all added mass.

fields.title: Size scaling and optimality
fields.finding: Only the two checked f5 gyration families are assessed. Larger manufactured tubes and thermal interactions are not validated.
fields.proposed_fix: Search further sections/topologies using independently checked force/eigen solutions and manufacturing limits before claiming a global radius minimum.

fields.title: Installed inventory
fields.finding: Systems100, node, installation and mooring lines are planning allowances. The 10 m full-endpoint margin is only about 31 kg.
fields.proposed_fix: Replace allowances with a component bill including sensors, fixtures, mounting, valves, access, repair and handling hardware.

fields.title: Gas and water location
fields.finding: Bores must be vented. Material water is counted once in material mass; exterior .1 kg/m² water is separate. More external water can erase the margin.
fields.proposed_fix: Verify bore venting, actual liquid retention/drainage and material moisture at launch.

fields.title: P2 comparability
fields.finding: P2 endpoints have different unqualified material, thermal, bond and life assumptions. 048 stopped at radius15.
fields.proposed_fix: Do not rank confidence from payload or axis count; any larger-radius 048 extension needs its own thermal and mechanical calculation.

fields.title: Reliability aggregation
fields.finding: Only an intact-member compression hazard envelope is reported. Independence, compression m=10, load sharing and reference volume are hypothetical.
fields.proposed_fix: Calibrate failure mechanisms and common causes before assembling a hull probability; do not substitute either number for installed reliability.

fields.title: Material and assembly transfers
fields.finding: Inherited Be/core/adhesive strengths, gamma, Q, thin film, scarf average stress, core-cell model and finish transfer do not establish installed hull capability. All 048/040/031 findings are retained.
fields.missing_evidence: Matched material, panel, joint, imperfection and shell tests.

fields.title: Joint weather distributions
fields.finding: MIL marginals do not supply complete coincident T/p/RH. Low-pressure data used are at 1 km, not sea level. Surface and joint hot-humid profiles need declared pressure/lapse assumptions; percentages are not global annual flyability.
fields.missing_evidence: A chosen site/mission joint sounding distribution and design-event definition.

fields.title: Different designs versus one vehicle
fields.finding: Design-family maps reoptimize geometry by weather condition and optimism set. Original ISA hulls fail the inherited pressure screen in some lower-altitude/high-pressure weather. Separate fixed-geometry full-range hulls and their lower lift margins are supplied.
fields.missing_evidence: Choose a build and operating pressure/temperature envelope before an operating claim.

fields.title: Conditional thermal weather scenario
fields.finding: The coupled map shifts inherited clear-sky offsets with air temperature. Cloud, solar, wind, wet optical response, actual dry-sky radiation and thermally coupled buoyancy are not a measured joint weather model.
fields.missing_evidence: Measured optics and local sky/solar/wind histories; coupled thermal validation.

fields.title: Cold interface boundary
fields.finding: About 277 K air is the cold edge of the inherited minimum-W screen in the scanned core range. A 0.05 K interval separates optimistic exclusion from first fully feasible tabulation. Source strength transfer and restraint dominate this numerical precision.
fields.missing_evidence: Cold assembled-interface tests and validated spatial restraint.

fields.title: Dew/frost rate and retention
fields.finding: Large-sphere convection, Lewis analogy, grey sky, constant capacities, nucleation, droplet pinning, emissivity under wetting and the cold frost scenario are unmeasured. All deposition is retained. Constant-climate dry-start results do not predict a wet-start transient.
fields.missing_evidence: Coating coupons and large-curvature wetting/thermal night measurements.

fields.title: Exterior water and rewetting
fields.finding: The 0.1 kg/m² exterior term is an allowance, not a measured retained film. Extra preexisting-water comparisons are arithmetic; no wet-start evaporation or drainage was solved. Interior absorption may recover after baking.
fields.missing_evidence: Drainage, water uptake, seal moisture and repeated-night exposure tests.

fields.title: Water-control installed costs
fields.finding: Drainage retention, low-emittance switching, cover hardware, heaters, cables and power-system installation are unpriced. Battery conversion uses the inherited 108 usable Wh/kg planning assumption; no mass-free mitigation is credited.
fields.missing_evidence: An installed bill and wet-environment performance for the selected mitigation.

fields.title: Gas service assumptions
fields.finding: Leakage, scarf permeability, 90% conditioning and connected core pores are projected. The 24h pressure/inventory calculation is a conditional bound on sampled geometries, not a sealed-life result or a measured temperature law.
fields.missing_evidence: Whole-hull leaks, pore venting, desorption and permeability versus temperature.

fields.title: Retained mechanical weather conventions
fields.finding: Wind load, pad sizing and reference convection retain 048 reference-density conventions. Mean centre pressure omits a full finite-height hydrostatic shell load. Fatigue, local support details, control and propulsion remain outside the payload screen.
fields.missing_evidence: Weather-dependent installed loads, local support design and controlled-flight analysis.

fields.title: Near-boundary numerical interpretation
fields.finding: Tables are projections with interpolation and scanned geometry bounds. Reported 0.1 K limits should not be interpreted as operational tolerances or probabilistic accuracy. Numerical checks do not validate the inherited material models.
fields.missing_evidence: Independent card check and higher-fidelity model validation.

fields.title: Saturation formula annotation
fields.finding: The es_water docstring names 1981; coefficients are the Buck 1996 update verified against NCAR. The code was preserved after pinning in the retry request. There is no numerical change.
fields.missing_evidence: Use the corrected source annotation in METHOD and SOURCE-AUDIT.

fields.title: Radius scope of hot-day failure
fields.finding: No sampled radius 10/12/15/20/30 m floats on the declared 10% hot profile, even with all four endpoints. This does not prove impossibility at every radius or under every pressure/profile assumption.
fields.missing_evidence: A separately defined expanded-size or revised-design study if required.

fields.open_issue: The 7.5752 g/m2 recipe and .09/.80 hemispherical optics are linked by a class-level transfer, not a matched Be coupon.
fields.grounding: Weigh and measure solar absorptance and hemispherical emittance on the exact stack, Be surface and process.

fields.open_issue: Classical IR emittance .65 is used as hemispherical for the model; the cited 2015 value is normal emittance and not interchangeable.
fields.grounding: Measure the hemispherical optical pair over temperature and relevant surface roughness.

fields.open_issue: Direct deposition omits carrier and PSA only conditionally. Native oxide, pretreatment, deposition stress and adhesion are unresolved.
fields.grounding: Qualify a prepared curved Be panel with thermal cycling and peel/adhesion testing; weigh all treatment layers.

fields.open_issue: Layer-density calculations and 10% application allowance are not measured installed weights.
fields.grounding: Measure total coating, edge seal, repairs, masking effects and coverage variation per finished area.

fields.open_issue: AZ93/Z93/SolarWhite minimum useful thickness is sourced but installed dry areal mass is not.
fields.grounding: Weigh matched coated Be witnesses, including paint primer; resolve SolarWhite reflectance/absorptance heading.

fields.open_issue: The lightest 0.5 mil Ag/FEP tape's catalog part number is TBD, despite a specification entry.
fields.grounding: Confirm an actual offered construction and as-delivered adhesive weight without treating a catalog row as availability.

fields.open_issue: Silver/FEP stainless-steel peel results do not qualify Be, overlaps, edges or repair strips.
fields.grounding: Test the complete Be/tape construction and weigh required edge seals and surface preparation.

fields.open_issue: Space heritage and base-FEP weathering do not establish atmospheric coating/PSA/metal lifetime.
fields.grounding: Measure combined UV, humidity, rain, corrosion, handling and thermal-cycle changes for the selected finish.

fields.open_issue: 0.1 kg/m2 is an assumed retained exterior liquid layer, not a measurement or a moisture-uptake property.
fields.grounding: Measure dew/rain/frost retention and drainage at hull orientations; specify dry-operating limits if claiming zero.

fields.open_issue: Primary dry optical values are used alongside an exterior liquid mass. Assumed wet optics are sensitivities only.
fields.grounding: Measure wet/frosted optical properties and solve the coupled condensation/evaporation thermal problem.

fields.open_issue: Historical 2U WVR does not establish equilibrium uptake for the proposed 200 F cure. TML is not a water inventory.
fields.grounding: Measure sorption/desorption and mass baseline for the exact 2U lot, cure and humidity cycle.

fields.open_issue: The 9.16% sensitivity derives from 2M immersed at 70 C with dissolution and a different cure.
fields.grounding: Use only as a severe sensitivity until exact 2U exposure data exist.

fields.open_issue: The 10 g/m2 structural-primer charge and 1% water fraction are planning assumptions; cited primer cure differs from 200 F.
fields.grounding: Define the actual two-interface primer, dry thickness, density, uptake and matched cure/Be compatibility.

fields.open_issue: CRIII durability data are not core moisture-uptake data. Metal nonabsorption does not remove coating/node/cell water.
fields.grounding: Measure the actual vented core's coating, contamination and condensed-water inventory.

fields.open_issue: PSA, deposited-stack and seam-polymer water fractions are assumptions.
fields.grounding: Measure each complete finish/seam construction's moisture baseline and change after conditioning.

fields.open_issue: Nominal density and film weights may already contain some moisture. The model conservatively adds a separate inventory.
fields.grounding: Establish dry-reference versus as-delivered masses to avoid an unknown double allowance.

fields.open_issue: 70 C preconditioning evidence is for exposed coupons; 90% removal and cure compatibility are not proven on a hull.
fields.grounding: Demonstrate a measured residual-water endpoint and required access, temperature, time and equipment.

fields.open_issue: Five well-mixed hull-volume purges are a resource scenario, not a qualified assembly process or material dry-out.
fields.grounding: Size the actual enclosure/glovebox and verify mixing, dew point, leak rate, exposure time and final material water.

fields.open_issue: 10% usable capacity and 95% capture are unqualified at hull pressure and temperature.
fields.grounding: Measure vacuum sorption isotherms, kinetics, dust control, regeneration and cartridge/retention mass.

fields.open_issue: 040's 90% volatile conditioning and water-equivalent pressure model remain assumptions shared by all routes.
fields.grounding: Measure species-resolved release for the chosen cure/process; use the zero-capture and unconditioned sensitivities.

fields.open_issue: Dry-night temperatures can fall below the inherited water partial-pressure dew point; dew mass is unknown.
fields.grounding: Resolve latent heat, air humidity transport, shading, sky condition, shedding and frost over the mission cycle.

fields.open_issue: Optical coating thermal resistance and its own residual stress are omitted.
fields.grounding: Measure or bound through-thickness resistance and coating stress for the installed stack.

fields.open_issue: The primary 037b account separates mean scarf and free-edge shear. An added scalar interaction can erase the thin-tape margin.
fields.grounding: Validate coincident load paths, peel and free-edge behavior on the matched curved joint.

fields.open_issue: The new finish does not repair the original 250 F minimum-strength free-edge failure. The 200 F stress-free state remains conditional.
fields.grounding: Measure residual strains and qualify 2U/primer strength, durability and cure against 037b/CHECK-037b findings.

fields.open_issue: For fixed emittance .80, the declared legacy day/full-cycle screen limits alpha to about .1665 at the source geometry.
fields.grounding: Set optical end-of-life limits and measure aged coupons; this number is a model threshold, not a life prediction.

fields.open_issue: 031 weather mass/pressure and 037 thermal environments remain separate model inputs.
fields.grounding: Choose a joint atmospheric, solar, wind and water exposure before claiming mission-level float.

fields.open_issue: Least sets depend on the four declared optimism axes, minimax interpolation and scalar equations; they are not measured allowable properties.
fields.grounding: Ground each retained axis and replace the surrogate with validated coupled structural behavior.

fields.open_issue: Ground-gas and ideal heat calculations are resource lower bounds; equipment, labor, pumping, cycle duration and currency cost are unsourced.
fields.grounding: Develop a matched process and obtain measured energy/use and equipment quotations.

fields.open_issue: 0.20 kg/m² paint+primer remains assumed; the marginal R12/R15 results are sensitive to installed coating mass.
fields.grounding: Weigh prepared, coated Be witnesses at the required optical performance, including primer, repairs and coverage variation.

fields.open_issue: Filed 037b's 200 F stress-free state, compliant-core/free-edge model and balanced-force argument are adopted conditionally.
fields.grounding: Measure actual stress-free state and layer-wise residual strains; validate the free-edge and global/crimp assumptions on a curved matched panel.

fields.open_issue: 031 buoyancy/pressure and 037 solar temperatures are separate environments.
fields.grounding: Define the combined mission and compute/test its complete thermal cycle with the Admiral's chosen weather envelope.

fields.open_issue: Compression strength is nonbinding under the scarf cap. Marginal face-tuple floats receive elasticity credit from 033's coupled historical E/Fcy tuple.
fields.grounding: Measure lot, orientation and formed-condition elastic modulus and compression, and state whether the design credits the coupled historical tuple.

fields.open_issue: Film weights do not establish adhesive shear, peel, flatwise tension, fatigue or leakage on Be/5056.
fields.grounding: Test the exact film, primer, surface treatment, cure and honeycomb geometry.

fields.open_issue: The effective global coefficient and Vc branch convention lack whole-hull imperfection validation.
fields.grounding: Use measured imperfections, orthotropic shell analysis and correlated physical buckling tests.

fields.open_issue: Q=.33–.82 is a selectable model factor rather than a qualified lower-bound allowable.
fields.grounding: Correlate matched sandwich wrinkle specimens across relevant wavelengths and defects.

fields.open_issue: Corrected thermal quadrature does not qualify the 037b homogenized free-edge model, local hardpoint restraint or joint coincidence.
fields.grounding: Compare thermal maps, strain and interface damage on curved instrumented panels.

fields.open_issue: The 10 MPa mean-shear screen and worst-direction thermal addition do not resolve scarf peel, voids or intersections.
fields.grounding: Weigh and load/leak-test full process scarf intersections under thermal cycling.

fields.open_issue: Low-radius face gauges are outside the cited standard sheet gauge envelope; spherical coverage and rejection rates are unresolved.
fields.grounding: Confirm formed stock supply and make a dimensioned panel/seam/mouldline manufacturing account.

fields.open_issue: Typical CR-III properties, weak shear direction and scalar elasticity are transferred to a formed shell.
fields.grounding: Measure density, orthotropic stiffness, compression, shear and crushed/formed condition for the selected lot.

fields.open_issue: Heavy pad is sized to mean crush and a plate formula; punching, peel and hull load distribution remain open.
fields.grounding: Resolve the complete mooring attachment and validate with combined pressure/tether tests.

fields.open_issue: The 20 m/s pad supplies only about 0.432 of the 70 kn capacity.
fields.grounding: Resize the attachment for the actual required load; a mass-only lighter-pad result is not an assembly pass.

fields.open_issue: Uniform Cp=1 and aligned gust velocity are load surrogates; 70 kn is the governing modeled pressure.
fields.grounding: Resolve pressure distribution and transient tether/flight loads for the chosen configuration.

fields.open_issue: Ambient trapped gas consumes lift and changes inner/outer face load paths; late venting is a separate transient.
fields.grounding: Specify and demonstrate cell venting or analyze/test the sealed-cell pressure distribution and failure transient.

fields.open_issue: 30–50 kg service is nested in 100 kg systems and held fixed with radius; there is no installed bill of materials.
fields.grounding: Provide a weighed scalable hardware, support, controls and wiring bill with the remaining systems allocation.

fields.open_issue: Reference .001 mbar L/(s m) seam leakage and 10 Barrer scarf permeability are scenarios, not measured acceptances.
fields.grounding: Measure conditioned full-seam/port leakage and species permeation under mission pressure and temperature.

fields.open_issue: 90% inventory removal, one-day release kinetics and water-only desorption composition are unverified.
fields.grounding: Measure finite species inventories and desorption rates after a validated conditioning process.

fields.open_issue: 100 m centre altitude and both weather sets are choices for comparison, not an approved terrain/operations requirement.
fields.grounding: Have the Admiral choose the mission envelope and reserve policy; retain all three current accounts.

fields.open_issue: Actual joining and the retained 5% floor produce different margins and least sets; neither closes an unmeasured installed joining bill.
fields.grounding: Close unlisted joining/edge/repair costs with a weighed assembly bill before releasing any retained allowance.

fields.open_issue: Local hardpoints, tolerances, penetrations, rejected parts and repairs are not independently itemized beyond retained allowances.
fields.grounding: Reconcile the complete installed bill and load-path drawing; do not assign an installed-hull SF from the scored scalar screens.

fields.grounding: Choose an available process and demonstrate both installed weight and bond/leak performance.

fields.open_issue: The least-optimism ranking holds over R10/12/15/20/30 for the selected 3/8–1.0 core only.
fields.grounding: Treat other radii/core grades and pressure/weather reserve policies as separate design choices requiring recomputation.

fields.claim: 037's shear-lag screen holds each face at the core's expansion (0.227 after the 250 F cure). That needs the core to carry 47 times the in-plane force at which its walls yield. CR-1457, Hexcel AGU 075b and NASA TM-4585 treat the core's in-plane stiffness and thermal force as negligible; on that premise the continuous core carries no mismatch shear and a free core edge reads 1.17 / 0.83.
fields.needed_to_ground: A curved Be/CR-III panel cured with AF 163-2U, cycled over 271-302 K, strain-gauged at a core splice, at a face scarf and in the field, then sectioned.

fields.claim: The free-edge shear uses this seat's homogenised model: K_biax from wall stretching (uniform cell 0.5 E rho*/rho_s; doubled ribbon walls 0.45), a linear shear profile over half the core depth, and a 16 mm transfer length, about 1.7 cells. Homogenisation is marginal there and cell-scale peaks are not modelled. The W direction governs over L on both strengths.
fields.needed_to_ground: A cell-resolved finite-element model of a free core edge, or the panel test above.

fields.claim: The cure leaves the faces in compression balanced by core tension. This card takes it as not driving global buckling or crimping, because the wall's net membrane force is unchanged (this seat's argument). It adds it in full to yield, wrinkling, dimpling and the scarf; for wrinkling that is conservative, since the core's tension near the face resists the wrinkle.
fields.needed_to_ground: A sandwich-shell buckling analysis with the layer-wise residual state.

fields.claim: 028b's fixed 30:1 scarf binds at its projected 10 MPa screen, so the cure compression costs usage (0.972 to 1.052); 028's sizing rule restores it at 30.44:1 for 0.16 kg. The 10 MPa screen is not a measured Be scarf allowable, and a filled core splice at the scarf may change the local face stress.
fields.needed_to_ground: A measured Be scarf allowable and the splice-at-scarf detail.

fields.claim: 028b's faces are pinned by its fixed 30:1 scarf. Without any cure compression a 30.44:1 scarf would let them thin, to usage 0.894. 028b gives no reason for fixing 30:1, such as machining, overlap, peel or panel-edge limits. This card notes the lever and does not take it.
fields.needed_to_ground: 028b's owner states why the scarf is fixed at 30:1, or re-runs the least set with the scarf ratio free.

fields.claim: Whether 028's filled 0.5 mm core splice carries the core's in-plane force (no free edge) is not shown; the fill's modulus and its bond to the cut cell walls are unsourced.
fields.needed_to_ground: Splice-fill properties and a splice coupon in in-plane tension.

fields.claim: The residual is a sustained shear on the core. On the minimum-average W strength (25 psi) it reads 0.83 at a free edge after the 250 F cure. Honeycomb creep and day-night fatigue under sustained shear are not sourced.
fields.needed_to_ground: Sustained-load and cyclic shear data for CR-III 5056 3/8-1.0.

fields.claim: The cure-or-Tg rule (108-121 C for AF 163-2U) is sourced qualitatively; no measured stress-free temperature or relaxed fraction for AF 163 was found.
fields.needed_to_ground: A bimaterial-strip or panel-curvature measurement with the actual cure cycle.

fields.claim: Room-temperature pastes (EA 9394 class) carry no sourced honeycomb bond data, fillet mass or flatwise strength; they are priced at AF's areal weight.
fields.needed_to_ground: Honeycomb flatwise and climbing-drum data for a room-temperature system at a weighed areal mass.

fields.claim: Hexcel prints only thickness-direction expansion for glass and aramid cores; their in-plane values are proxies here. The carbon core UCF-145 (12.8 kg/m3, second-hand shear data, W strength 97 kPa) has no sourced in-plane expansion or compressive modulus and is not priced.
fields.needed_to_ground: In-plane expansion and compressive data for candidate non-metallic cores.

fields.claim: NASA/SDSU co-cured-panel studies report the face/core cure mismatch as cell-wall distortion and face waviness. That is a source of the wrinkle coefficient's waviness (MAINLINE-032), not of bond shear.
fields.needed_to_ground: Measured face waviness after an AF 163-2U cure on CR-III.

fields.claim: 5056-H39 foil properties were not sourced: the wall stiffness uses 5056-H14 bulk (67 GPa, 2700 kg/m3) and the wall allowable the measured 5052-H39 foil yield (227.5 MPa).
fields.needed_to_ground: 5056-H39 foil modulus and yield.

fields.claim: Inserts, closeouts and 037's mooring pads constrain the mismatch locally; they are not scored here.

fields.issue: No site elevation, terrain, minimum hull clearance, altitude ceiling or required 500m condition has been authorised. Centre 10m is ground tangency at sea level; 100m is only an illustrative 90m clearance.
fields.next_evidence: Specify centre-height range relative to surveyed terrain, weather set, clearance and whether 500m means ISA free float or a minimum on every design day.

fields.issue: 019 specifies conditions at one altitude, not a vertical profile. A 6.5K/km lapse and constant e/p were imposed. At the 100m floor, isothermal optimistic climate mass is 11.73kg versus 55.34kg with the chosen lapse; both-weather values are 403.66 versus 441.77kg.
fields.next_evidence: Supply measured or approved temperature, pressure, humidity and inversion profiles, including joint extremes and occurrence probabilities.

fields.issue: The conservative high-pressure humid day becomes supersaturated in the all-weather 500m-floor diagnostic. The 0/10/100m-floor main cases are unsaturated in the stated model. Continuing an unsaturated lapse through cloud is not a physical forecast.
fields.next_evidence: Use a moist atmospheric profile with cloud/condensate treatment; do not treat that diagnostic height as an operational guarantee.

fields.issue: A fixed evacuated hull has one passive equilibrium per weather profile and carried load. Positive C raises its ISA float altitude; C=0 cannot float at 500m ISA and satisfy the illustrative sea-level-ground clearance on both 019 hot-day extremes. Static equilibrium does not provide station keeping.
fields.next_evidence: Resolve the mission requirement; size active altitude control, tethering, launch, landing, descent-rate and gust response if needed.

fields.issue: Climate is absent mass; water, contamination and gas are carried mass. 021 rev1 has a 5% placeholder, no separate climate rows or explicit seam budget. Recasting that placeholder is a new budget assumption.
fields.next_evidence: Approve one common itemised gross mass ledger, including payload status, before treating cross-card points as the same vehicle.

fields.issue: SR-200 345MPa is a tensile minimum transferred to compression. The 379.2MPa endpoint is a historical lot result; continuous interpolated strength is not a procureable design allowable. 021 rev1 inherits 283MPa at E290GPa.
fields.next_evidence: Obtain gauge-, direction-, lot-, temperature- and post-form compression and modulus allowables.

fields.issue: The least-set P2 points need multi-metre square-equivalent panels at roughly 0.65–0.72mm face gauge. The nominal today 0.9144m seam-equivalent stock size is itself not established at those gauges.

fields.issue: The hemisphere-derived 0.2/1 branch rule and 018 interpolation to 0.2+0.4min(Vc,2) have not been validated for the complete sphere. Numerical least-set membership is conditional on these bounds.
fields.next_evidence: Correlate full-shell imperfection-sensitive nonlinear analysis and representative structural testing.

fields.issue: Wrinkle coefficients between 0.33 and 0.82 and published typical core properties are used for a curved sandwich. The catalogue includes transferred moduli and scaled cores; the winner is the sourced light 5056 core, but no assembly allowable exists.
fields.next_evidence: Test curvature, cell depth, orthotropy, face/core bond and biaxial wrinkling/crimp/crush/dimpling at service temperature.

fields.issue: P2 seams and bond films are a mass recipe, not checked structural joints. P3 percent joints are an allowance, not strength or rotational stiffness. Folded source joints sized at p0 cannot automatically take a larger float pressure.
fields.next_evidence: Size and qualify seal, splice, node and load-introduction details at the maximum service pressure, including stiffness, eccentricity, fatigue and leakage.

fields.issue: The passing P3 keeps a 3900MPa SiC tube compression value, 410GPa modulus, 1.5GPa/970kg/m3 film and metre-scale thin curved tubes. These are not a demonstrated assembly or a safe tensile/bending allowable.
fields.next_evidence: Carry tube-scale brittle reliability, post-form flaw statistics, film biaxial/creep/UV/seam/barrier properties and manufacture into the model.

fields.issue: FIX-A triangular load sharing is used. FIX-B SP-8007 axial-cylinder knockdown is transferred to curved ceramic members; Perry and k=0.2 global continuum equations remain inherited idealisations.
fields.next_evidence: Validate curved member local buckling, imperfections, ceramic tension/compression interaction and discrete-frame modes with actual node stiffness.

fields.issue: 022b's s/(16R) displacement loss is applied as reduced volume at every altitude. Film shape may change with pressure, and the spherical arc/member model is approximate for 6m bays on R10m.
fields.next_evidence: Solve coupled membrane shape, true enclosed volume, pressure and frame load path; verify the global continuum approximation and spacing bounds.

fields.issue: Mode scores use uniform centre pressure, no internal-pressure relief and fixed material properties. Local bottom pressure is about a further 0.1% higher, while gradients, thermal mismatch, wind, attached loads and descent transients are unscored.
fields.next_evidence: Set structural design factors and loads independently of the SF=1 screening threshold; include nonuniform pressure and thermal/wind/handling loads.

fields.issue: The calculation retains optimistic 019 nonclimate loads and the full 100kg system floor even on conservative weather. This isolates weather; it does not qualify the conservative pump/battery/rain/contamination hardware package.
fields.next_evidence: Qualify 24h sealed service and internal gas inventory, or recalculate with measured leakage, pumping, rain/ice retention and all installed systems.

fields.finding: The cure-included light-finish R10–15 rows, old040 R30 account and050 original048-account weather extension are different accounts; no common cure-inclusive R10–30 optimum is claimed.

The bake's 90% removal is 048's acceptance target, and DuPont says Nomex needs at least 100 C to dry fully against 048's 70 C bake.

fields.issue: No candidate has a retrieved 2–3 m complete-tube compression scale, m and effective size. Measure a relevant population, including joints/process/environment; do not substitute tensile or flexural fits.
Manufacturer typical compression averages are not Weibull scales, design allowables or specimen-size fits. All multipliers against them are explicitly hypothetical.
Virtual matrix/transverse/shear constants, density mixtures and homogenized B=0/D=Qbar t³/12 need construction-specific evidence; actual pultruded/wrapped geometry and fibre fractions may differ.
Transverse compression, interlaminar damage, microbuckling, defects, matrix shear and compression-after-impact remain incomplete. No CFRP tube is established to be non-brittle.
Peak-stress orthotropic Donnell screen with inherited gamma is unvalidated. The change from .6E axial demand materially reduces the baseline 019 margin.
Rigid joints, global factor0.2, follower-pressure fan and lack of film tangent stiffness are projections; proof by nonlinear imperfection-sensitive structure tests/analysis is absent.
Every sampled loss triggers a second overload in the retained design. A changed load path, stronger joints and supported film bay must be designed with its mass charged.
Two static edge removals per construction/reserve are not an exhaustive edge search, transient rupture chain or lifetime cascade probability.
Pressure history/contact patch, preload, dynamic plate/shell response, effective flaw area and matching member-break fit are missing. Uncalibrated probabilities are not measured risks.
First-ply stress, leakage and complete-member severance are distinct events; tow load sharing cannot supply an impact Weibull population.

750 equal whole-member populations, 3 m reference weights and 1 cm³ volume weights are alternative hypotheses. Real compressive failure or composite load sharing may not follow weakest-link volume scaling.

Saint-Gobain sheet/web m/E/rho entries differ; Specialty Materials metric and imperial entries conflict; reported PremaTech flexural mean/scale are not internally exact. Preserve source populations instead of silently combining them.
GE's >1 GPa CMC compression concerns hot component averages; projected RT tube use and assumed E/G/rho are not justified by those data.
Fixed OD, actual f5 member lengths, retained film/joints and declared layups bound this study. Passing witnesses are not global minima or commercially demonstrated tubes.
Hail flux, repeated impact, humidity/temperature, manufacturing scatter, stress corrosion and proof-test damage are unmodeled. No actual lifetime Pf is identified.
The inherited flat stiffness/density trend does not constrain defect reduction, strength scatter, interfaces, proof testing or structural redundancy.

fields.proposed_fix: Measure leak and WVTR after representative forming, flex, handling, UV and abrasion; include seams and penetrations.

fields.title: Carrier and coating weights
fields.finding: ALD paper omits PET gauge; R10 ML3 zero-payload carrier limit is28.07um. SiOx/Verreal coat2g/m2 and foil adhesive3g/m2 are allowances.
fields.proposed_fix: Weigh the complete final laminate including all carrier, coatings, primer, adhesive and opacity layers. Do not use the12um recipe as a sourced product.

fields.title: ALD evidence floor and aging
fields.finding: Claimed sub1e-5 performance is below the stated5e-5 instrument sensitivity; oxide durability and PET transfer are unqualified.
fields.proposed_fix: Confirm detection limit, reporting bounds, long-term oxide protection and flex performance on the final carrier.

fields.title: Light and thermal protection
fields.finding: Added Al opacity and inherited white/attachment package are not verified OD4 or actual optical/thermal properties for new laminates.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure spectral transmission, aged absorptivity/emissivity and adhesion of the complete package.

fields.title: Whole-hull leakage and dry gas
fields.finding: Inherited seam/node/port leaks and dry-species permeability are assumptions. Dry ingress limits nominal ultrabarrier intervals.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure full pressure-rise/species curves and actual leak rates; resolve all pressure-normalised permeability units.

fields.title: Adsorbent equilibrium transfer
fields.finding: 6wt%working screen applies to the source3A isotherm,1wt%initial moisture and333K maximum bed temperature. Vendor/cation variation and contamination are unknown.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure actual batch isotherm and cyclic working capacity at10–33Pa with the relevant temperatures and co-adsorbates.

fields.title: Adsorption transport and heat rejection
fields.finding: R10 seven-day SiOx system requires about277m3/h effective water conductance and16.54W peak heat rejection.5kg distribution/monitoring plus25%housing are unverified.
fields.proposed_fix: Demonstrate distributed access, dust retention, thermal coupling and bed temperature without unpriced fans or pumps; weigh functional hardware.

fields.title: Conditioning and regeneration
fields.finding: Initial90%conditioning and1day release time constant are inherited proxies. Ground350C regeneration energy assumes cp1kJ/kg/K and2xloss factor.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure drydown, repeat-cycle residual moisture, vacuum pumping work, cooldown and handling. Regenerate outside the PBO enclosure.

fields.title: Power and spare-mass fragility
fields.finding: R10 seven-day screen has1.12kgpayload.5W monitoring instead of0.5W makes it negative; additional transport hardware could erase it.
fields.proposed_fix: Build an actual electrical/installation bill and mission duty cycle, including sensors, batteries, mounts, thermal parts and contingency.

fields.title: PBO humidity-dose criterion
fields.finding: 5%of cold saturation is an inference from dry protected-yarn evidence, not a demonstrated long-term loaded-laminate safe boundary.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure loaded PBO/resin/interface strength retention under the full coupled moisture, temperature and light history.

fields.title: Aramid installed strength
fields.finding: 3GPa is conditioned yarn;95%retention,100%film efficiency and inherited thermal factor are optimistic assumptions.60%efficiency loses most favourable-weather closure.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure balanced membrane strength, creep, thermal mismatch, seams and long-term humid-service retention.

fields.title: UHMWPE creep
fields.finding: SK99/DM20 exceed1%creep over30days at900MPa/30C; thin strength-sized films are more highly stressed and warmer.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain stress/temperature/time creep and rupture data for actual laminate; do not apply a single900MPa rate to higher stresses.

fields.title: M5 and LCP evidence gaps
fields.finding: No qualified M5/PIPD humid-service membrane allowable found. Accessible LCP chart is relative, not absolute WVTR.
fields.proposed_fix: Obtain absolute gauge/rate/condition/areal-mass records for LCP and relevant loaded wet-strength data for M5 before numeric credit.

fields.title: 052 structural and weather assumptions
fields.finding: All favourable-member, nonlinear-shell, joint, film, water, mooring and weather limitations from052 remain open. Both-weather closes nowhere here.
fields.proposed_fix: Carry forward052NFI without dilution; confirm the entire actual structure and environmental loading.

fields.title: Local installation and free volume
fields.finding: Bed/housing volume is included but distribution stiffness, load introduction, detailed barrier solid volume and microlocal humidity are not resolved.
fields.proposed_fix: Integrate and test local mounts, thermal paths and humidity gradients; rerun structural/displacement accounting for final geometry.

fields.state: demonstrated in my elastic FE; unresolved against the 015b map
fields.note: 042 took the dimple tolerance 9.318-16.057 mm (width 0.357 m) from the 015b map as the shape that delivers gamma 0.564. My elastic FE of the 028b section (the CHECK-029 model) gives 0.511 and 0.469 there. It reaches 0.564 only at a dimple of 5.82 mm or less. Keeping the core within its typical shear strength at operating needs 2.38 mm or less (1.80 mm at the minimum strength). Keeping the outer face below 345 MPa needs 1.27 mm or less. The article seeds several amplitudes so that the test settles which is right.
fields.proposed_fix: Seed 2, 6 and 16 mm dimples (one article each) and report gamma against amplitude, not one number.

fields.state: carried from CHECK-029 C029-11 and recomputed for 028b
fields.note: On the 028b section, the core reaches CR III W typical shear (35 psi) at 24.9 kPa (16 mm dimple) and at 37.8 kPa (9.3 mm), long before the elastic limit. A test article at those amplitudes will most likely fail by core shear on the dimple flank (r about 280-430 mm) before global collapse. Its measured pressure is then a core-strength capacity, and the outcome table records the mode with the value.

The p_cl-matched 5052-O face (3.103 mm on a 20.929 mm core, h held) reproduces beryllium's elastic gamma within +2.8% and its core-shear onset within +2.6%. Its outer face reaches yield at 0.88 of beryllium's pressure; the operating-stress ratio matches to 0.99. Not matched: biaxial membrane stiffness (+31%, from nu 0.33 against 0.0752), the wrinkle margin (x4.0, so wrinkling is suppressed), beryllium's low-ductility fracture, and the line's Be compression premise (the match uses the 345 MPa tensile proxy). A Be confirmation article is needed before any qualification claim.
fields.proposed_fix: Re-match the stand-in thickness after 038 T1 measures SR-200 compression.

fields.note: The homogenized CR III core with E_in 0.01 MPa loses ellipticity at about 0.088 MPa shear, and these paths pass that at 7-11 kPa. So an FE on a mesh fine enough to resolve the dimple flank cannot predict the core's response there. The test, not the FE, has to supply it. The pre-test FE needs a sourced in-plane core law or a cell model.

In my elastic FE, the clamped edge of the 5 m cap yields the inner face and crushes the core at about 60 kPa. That is edge bending and not part of the sphere's behaviour. The dimple region itself matches the sphere: the limit is within +1.4%, core-shear onset within -0.4%, and outer-face yield within +0.5%.
fields.proposed_fix: Design a reinforced edge (face doublers, potted core ring) and check it before the build.

fields.note: The R30 section at 1/3 on R 10 m (0.822 / 34.20 mm) keeps R/h, Vc, dimple/t_eq and stresses, but the 9.5 mm cell is unscaled. That gives 4.5 cells per wrinkle wavelength against 13.6 at full R30, and cell/h of 0.27 against 0.09. Its cap needs a base radius of 3 m: 2.5 m gives -2.2% and 3 m gives +1.2%.

No commercial external-pressure chamber found takes a 5-6 m article; the largest found are 2.3 m ID (FET), 1.6 m (Matrix) and Tyne's TPT5 (4.5 m long). The rig is therefore evacuation under the cap plus a water head above it. The hydrostatic gradient over the 0.32-0.46 m rise is 3.1-4.5 kPa (about 3% at 120 kPa), and the pole sees the lowest pressure. Collapse dynamics under water and tank safety are open.

Under 90/95 normal tolerance statistics, three articles at 5% scatter need a mean of 0.815 to bound 0.564, and at 10% scatter it is impossible. Ten articles at 10% need 0.738. So a result counts under a validated-analysis rule: at least three articles per configuration, measured as-built shape, identified failure mode, and an elastic-plastic FE that predicts each within 10%. Precedent: NASA SBKF used 8 subscale and 2 full-scale cylinders.

No quotes and no contact. Unsourced: aerospace 3/8-1.0 core and SR-200 prices. The DIC purchase indicator is an AI-estimated range in a NIST notice. The 5052 price is a vendor guide plus retail listings. Labor uses 038's USD 150-250/h basis.
047's tolerance with yielding faces is not filed. The seeded amplitudes use 042's map tolerance and this card's FE series.
Reis 2017's plateau knockdown (0.447 at lambda 1) and its single-parameter scaling are for homogeneous elastic hemispheres. Their transfer to Vc near 1 sandwiches, with t_eq = sqrt(3) h, is unproven.
My FE is elastic (StVK) and axisymmetric. Its limits are elastic limits; with face yield and core failure the real capacity at these dimples is lower. Nonaxisymmetric modes are not modelled.

fields.finding: The dispatch calls 6.03 MPa measured. EUCASS2023-367 reports it as a nonlinear pressure-buckling simulation; its physical validation is axial compression.
fields.consequence: Agreement with 6.03 MPa is numerical benchmarking, not validation against a measured pressure-collapse shell.

fields.finding: The paper does not supply the hydrostatic/uniaxial strength ratio, plastic Poisson ratio, tensile behavior or hardening variant. Associated alpha=3/sqrt(2) is a projection; alternatives are explicit sensitivities.
fields.consequence: The uniaxial curve does not uniquely calibrate the multiaxial foam law.

fields.finding: The printed densification slope exceeds E=40 MPa. Converting all plotted total strains with epsilon_p=epsilon_total-sigma/E gives nonmonotone plastic strain. The conditional model retains the monotone portion and explicitly extrapolates its last hardening slope.
fields.consequence: Any path using extrapolation has material uncertainty beyond plot digitization. Full densification cannot be claimed fitted.

fields.finding: Figure 5 starts near 7500 MPa as labeled. The base uses the declared factor-of-ten interpretation (750 MPa) and J2 plasticity; the literal axis is a separate sensitivity.
fields.consequence: No unique sourced steel plasticity curve was recovered. The axis correction is not an established erratum. The plotted tensile curve is also transferred symmetrically to compression through the J2 assumption.

fields.finding: The radius arrow is ambiguous. The inherited outer-radius model and a 42.8 mm midsurface interpretation are separate cases. Baseline Gaussian offsets and reconstructed indentation-generated shapes are both evaluated; the original mesh and precise plastic-state import convention are unavailable.
fields.consequence: Remaining numerical differences cannot be assigned to the constitutive law alone.

fields.finding: The foam shear screen uses the chosen DF ellipse's implied virgin pure-shear yield strength. A measured PVC80 shear-rupture allowable was not recovered.
fields.consequence: First shear yield, later hardening and irreversible shear failure must not be conflated.

fields.finding: The new extension uses a documented corotational logarithmic-strain/Cauchy convention and an independently checked assembled tangent. It is not the original Abaqus model or an independently validated constitutive executable.
fields.consequence: Material-point and equilibrium checks do not establish equivalence to the paper's finite-strain integration.

fields.finding: Only axisymmetric equilibrium paths are followed; interfaces are perfectly bonded. A traced pressure peak does not prove stability against nonaxisymmetric or interface modes.
fields.consequence: The pressure peak is a conditional model result, not an installed-hull capacity.

fields.finding: CR III 5056 has distinct directional shear limits, compression peaks and crush plateau. Datasheet scalars do not identify postpeak curves, densification strains, unloading, mixed-mode interactions or shear rupture energy.
fields.consequence: A candidate directional law is stated in HONEYCOMB-TRANSFER.md, but no calibrated P2 gamma can be released.

fields.finding: The lead also needs thin-gauge beryllium compression/fracture data, admissible in-plane honeycomb behavior, bonds, imperfections, joints and a realizable ribbon layout.
fields.consequence: Matching a steel/PVC hemisphere does not remove the lead's existing strength violations or establish its gamma.

fields.finding: The Gaussian-imperfection paths have an earlier local maximum and descending branch before their largest traced pressure. Reconstructed-indentation paths differ.
fields.consequence: A largest-pressure comparison alone does not identify the first instability. Sampled turning points are retained; no dynamic jump or nonaxisymmetric stability is proved.

fields.note: AIAA S-120A and SAWE RP 7 tables are paywalled and were not opened. The allowances are NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1 (NTRS 20120013284), adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 Table 1. My map from maturity to its TRL rows is estimated to TRL 0-2, calculated to TRL 3-5 and measured to TRL 8. Different tables shift the numbers; no plausible table brings the concept-stage allowance below the 2.8-9.9% that the bills tolerate.

Faces, core, SiC, PBO and pads are classed calculated, because they are sized by analysis and none are built. Joints, films, seams, sleeves, nodes and primer are classed estimated (rules and catalog areal masses). The finish carries its own +10%; P3's joint allowance above the actual sleeves is its own margin. The 100 kg systems allowance, the vacuum-service charge, gas, contamination, retained water, weather headroom and the sag lift debit get none.

P2 bills at R20 and R30 are 040's (200 F fix) with 048's finish transferred: the 0.2 kg/m2 coating is replaced by 8.33 g/m2 plus 10 g/m2 primer plus absorbed water. Checked against 048 at R10-15 for the same subsets: differences of 0.2-9.2 kg. 048's cure-in-global and drying folds are not re-optimized at R20 or R30.
Geometry stays at the owners' optima. Re-optimizing with allowance-weighted masses could shift face/core splits slightly; it cannot close gaps of 579-6,410 kg.

The optimism the allowance would need is a linear extrapolation of payload in the least set's usage, from its zero-payload point to its endpoint. P2 would need usage 1.78-2.13 and P3 4.6-30. Payload is not linear in usage; the point is that every value exceeds 1.
Environmental allowances and debits carry no allowance here but have their own uncertainties. At 1 mm retained water, every R10-15 case already fails (048 fold). Weather cases are separate rows.
The same GSFC source adds a system-level margin, typically 30% for Pre-Phase-A concepts, above the itemized allowance. Applying it would only deepen every deficit.
053's most conservative thermal reading lowers P2 R10 by 0.6 kg. 054's week aloft leaves P3 +1.1 kg. P3's onboard-service rows are worse than ground. None changes a sign.

P2's cold edge is the inherited 037b/048 bond-interface screen (Be/Al CTE mismatch from the 200 F cure): outer-skin minimum >= 264.03 K. It is not validated by cold assembled-interface tests (050 NFI50-05). It applies on the ground as well as in flight: a moored hull also needs cover, heating or a low-emittance finish on cold clear nights.

Al + acrylic overcoat (Sheldahl film product, A 0.14, eps 0.05), TARC (a roof coating, cold state A ~0.25, sky-window eps 0.20) and the switchable eps 0.05 night state (050) are transfers to a Be skin. Installed mass, adhesion, UV and humidity life and wet optics are unknown; areal mass was held at MLCCAg's 8.33 g/m2. 048's legacy finish screen (037 day SF >= 1.678, full-cycle >= 1) was not evaluated. The static Al+AOC skin reaches 319 K by day at ISA. A switchable state must switch by skin temperature, not by sun: in its day state the edge is 269.7 K without sun credit.

Relief by climbing needs room: at Heathrow the -30 hPa design climbs 268 m median, 426 m at the 99th percentile and 510 m at most above the 100 m floor; the 0 hPa P3 design 60/198/270 m; floating free (no dump) 0.7-1.7 km. Airspace ceilings and traffic rules are not modelled.

Air admitted for relief or to dump lift cannot be pumped back in flight: 034's onboard pumps need 264-416 h (E2M28) or 8,062-12,709 h (KNF N920) at R10. Re-evacuation is a ground task, about 16-20 h per flown day at 052's effective ground speed (1574.9 m3/h per 4188.8 m3), against 24.5 h for a full evacuation. Energy is bracketed: ideal isothermal 23-50 kWh (R10) to 900-1,530 kWh (R30) per day; Edwards GXS-class sets list 1,900-2,200 m3/h and 7.5-29.5 kW rated across the family (not tied to a model). P3 admitted air must be dried for the 052/054 dry cavity. After a pressure fall, trim air lowers lift with no in-flight recovery.

The water-ballast bladder is charged at 2 % of capacity; pillow-tank listings give 0.35-0.93 % for the fabric of 1,500-10,000 L ground tanks, not flight hardware. Capacity is the cold-day excess lift: 322-536 kg at R10 and 13.9-19.7 t at R30 for the widest bands. Refill is at the mooring; drain control and load paths are not designed. The dump is needed only to hold altitude at fixed payload; a variable payload can absorb the excess.

Heathrow 2 m observations are mapped to the 100 m centre with 050's 6.5 K/km lapse and a constant vapour mole fraction. Real night inversions (warmer aloft: helps P2's cold edge) and daytime superadiabatic layers (cooler aloft: helps lift) are not represented.

The primary cold test applies 050's clear-sky depressions every night (24.9 K) and day (9.9 K, no sun credit): conservative. The cloud-aware sensitivity mixes clear and overcast (2 K) sky radiance by observed oktas; 3.1 % of hours have no cloud report and are treated as clear. Wind is fixed at 2 m/s.

A day counts only if all 24 UTC hours lie inside the band; days with a missing hour are dropped (87,354 of 87,648 hours complete). One site, 2014-2023. Gusts beyond the 70 kn design, precipitation, hail (045), icing and lightning are outside the band. The fractions are not availability guarantees.

P3's account has no cold screen: SiC/PBO/sleeve CTE mismatch and the PBO film at low temperature are unscreened, so its band is open on the cold side. Its dry-cavity humidity limit tightens as the film gets colder (052), shortening the ground interval on cold days.

P3 mass against design load is a log-linear fit per item through 052's three loads (97.2-99.7 kPa): SiC tubes ~p^0.445 at the endpoints, PBO ~p^1.0, sleeves ~p^2. The full-range load 103.95 kPa is a 4.3 % extrapolation. 052's ISA payloads are reproduced within 0.06 kg; its force field and sizing were not re-solved.
With 057's sourced concept-stage mass-growth allowance (15-30 %) no hull of either lead floats at any radius; every band here assumes flight-proven masses.

Thrust: momentum theory with FM 0.70, motor/drive 0.85, 0.5 kg/kW, 108 Wh/kg usable. Kite: CL 1.0, 0.2 kg/m2 sail and spars, 1/7-power shear from 10 m. A kite needs a tether; load introduction into the shell is unscreened, as for 045's mooring.

Heater, cable and battery integration are unpriced; 12-hour clear-night energy at 050's 108 Wh/kg usable. Flight use is limited to about 1-2 K at R10; ground power on the mooring is assumed available.

On the ground (centre at z = R) on a high-pressure day the load exceeds the 100 m floor's; relief by admitting air covers it, but 050's grid starts at 100 m and the moored load path is not re-checked.

No relieved hull of either lead floats on any MIL-HDBK-310 hot marker up to R30: 10 % hot day at R30 P2 -2,956 to -3,853 kg, P3 -886 kg (0.7 % of its mass). This is not an impossibility proof beyond R30.
Least optimism sets are the fewest axes at their endpoints (usage 1) reaching a coverage target, with the best finish, design pressure and relief; common-usage roots below 1 were not refined.
Every fixed hull is sized at its finish's own clear-night cold threshold, as 050's builds; finish mass differences come from the day thermal gradient and curvature terms only.

fields.claim: P3's ponds use 024's sag crown and mean, 052's bay size through its sag debit, a quadratic dish and a planar bay pattern near the top. 052 does not fix the frame's orientation; the pond mass spans 5-171 kg at R 10 with it.

The peak member load, 775 kN, exceeds the largest sourced composite strut test (121.7 klb, 541 kN). Bonded fittings failed at about 70% of design ultimate.

fields.direction: the elastic benchmark endpoints are not structural
fields.note: The card's elastic imperfect endpoints (13.956916 / 13.843652 MPa) are set by the St. Venant-Kirchhoff foam collapsing under the dimple, not by shell buckling. With nu 0, StVK foam carries at most E/(3 sqrt 3) = 7.70 MPa in uniaxial compression, at stretch 1/sqrt 3 = 0.577. At each maximum the foam's most compressive principal stress is near that limit and its smallest stretch is past it: flat 96 x 2f x 12c -7.61 MPa at stretch 0.229; dimple 96 x 2f x 4c -7.48 MPa at 0.353; under displacement control at the card's mesh, a flat foam point reaches stretch 0.0096 at 13.78 MPa, and the path keeps rising to 14.219 through such states. So the endpoint depends on the core mesh and the path. At the card's mesh the flat first critical point is 13.785 (arc-length), with my load control at 14.051 and displacement control at 14.219. Refining the core (4/6/8/10/12 elements) gives 13.785/13.576/13.553/13.431/13.372 MPa, not converged; for the dimple (4/6/8/10) it gives 13.838/13.649/13.552/13.495. Meridional refinement is converged: 13.576/13.566/13.566 at 96/192/384 with 6 core elements. The lead models are not affected by this mechanism: their honeycomb normal strain stays below 1% at the limits (0.36 to 0.78%), while StVK collapse needs 42%. Their core has a different, shear instability (C029-10).
fields.proposed_fix: Fix card, if the EUCASS benchmark is reused: replace the StVK foam with a compressible hyperelastic or crushable-foam law and report the endpoint against core refinement. No lead number changes.

fields.direction: benchmark
fields.note: The linear gap (30.21717 against the paper's 27.53 MPa) is not the mesh, which is converged, and not the load stiffness, which raises the value by 1.70%. It is not the through-thickness discretization either. Two candidates fit. (a) Fig. 4(a) draws the 42.80 mm radius arrow to a point inside the wall, so the reference surface is not stated. Read as the mid-surface radius, it gives 28.076 / 28.061 MPa (+2.0% / +1.8%), closing about 80% of the gap. Read at the foam/outer-face interface, it gives 29.738 / 29.715. (b) E_steel of about 187 GPa closes it (190 GPa gives 27.877, 200 GPa gives 29.049), but Table 1 states 210 GPa. A third candidate, the paper's own discretization (about 2 foam solids through 3.1 mm, 1.04 mm continuum-shell faces, tie constraints), was not tested.

fields.direction: supports the card's NFI-029-FOAM, -FACE-PLASTICITY and -STEEL-CURVE
fields.note: At the paper's 6.03 MPa, my elastic imperfect flat model (96 x 2f x 4c) has the foam at -3.15 MPa principal stress and the outer face at 1015 MPa von Mises (inner face 363). The foam passes the Fig. 3 plateau, read at about 1.4 MPa, at 2.75 MPa. The face passes 750 MPa at 4.56 MPa: Fig. 5 as printed starts near 7,500 MPa, which is impossible for 201 steel, and reads about 750 MPa if the axis is off by 10. The perfect model at 12.45 MPa: outer face 1014 MPa at the clamped edge (750 MPa reached at 9.29 MPa), foam -1.11 MPa. This is consistent with the paper's note that its perfect model buckles at the bottom edge. The factor of 2.3 is constitutive, so no elastic model should be expected to close it.

On graded meshes it falls with refinement: 230.386 (512), 209.173 (1024), 200.792 (2048), 198.219 (4096), 197.593 kPa (8192); 4096 with grading 2.0 gives 197.582, and 2 face x 6 core gives 198.174. A Winkler estimate gives 677.7 MPa = 187.5 kPa for 021b, with wavelength 36.7 mm; for 021 it gives 913.4 MPa = 308.2 kPa, so 021 is unaffected (191.476 / 160.132 at graded 2048). fields.direction: numerical and modelling; extends NFI-029-HOMOGENIZATION
fields.note: The card's core law, C = diag(E_in, E_n, G) in the tangent/normal frame with zero Poisson coupling, loses ellipticity under transverse shear tau. The plane-wave acoustic tensor has det = E_in G + 2 tau x (E_in + G) + x^2 (E_in E_n + 4 tau^2) + 2 tau x^3 (G + E_n) + G E_n x^4, which turns negative for some x = k_n/k_t once tau exceeds 0.088 MPa (W) or 0.088 MPa (L) at the card's E_in of 0.01 MPa. The thresholds are 2.58 / 2.61 MPa at 1 MPa. The card's static paths reach 0.088 MPa at lead021-W 11.0 kPa, lead021-L 11.3 kPa, lead021b-W 7.3 kPa, lead021b-L 6.9 kPa. The discretization sees it once elements are a few millimetres long, below the 9.5 mm cell size. With the far shift (-1000, the true lowest eigenvalues) on graded 4096 x 1.35 (about 3.5 mm): stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-W-a46: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.013; 60.0 kPa lowest -569.718; 80.0 kPa lowest -1059.992; 90.7 kPa lowest -1016.326; stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-L-a46: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.017; 60.0 kPa lowest -55.528; 90.0 kPa lowest -1077.184. The negative eigenvalues come in clusters of nearly equal values on the dimple flank at r 340 to 570 mm (anti-phase for L, mixed for W). On 4096 with grading 2.0 (about 1.35 mm): -0.595 already at 30 kPa, an exact eigenpair (residual 3e-7) whose small-strain quotient 617.9 is cancelled by the initial-stress term -589.1. The core carries 99.97% of the material and 100.00% of the initial-stress energy. The 021b W lowest mode at 60 kPa (-569.7) has 99.95% of its material energy in the core. Its worst element is a core element 3.31 mm long, where the core stress reaches 0.78 MPa. The 021b L lowest mode at 60 kPa (-55.5) has 99.75% of its material energy in the core. Its worst element is a core element 3.24 mm long, where the core stress reaches 0.82 MPa. Its outer-face motion has 33 sign changes over r 302 to 409 mm, a wavelength of 6.5 mm (about two elements; inner/outer correlation -0.99). That is mesh-scale, not the 37 mm wrinkle. With E_in 1 MPa and G_in 0.5 MPa that state's lowest eigenvalue is 0.0197. Along the paths with E_in 1 MPa: stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-W-a46-ein1: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.013; 60.0 kPa lowest 0.011; 80.0 kPa lowest 0.010; 90.7 kPa lowest 0.009; stabsig-4096g135-lead021b-L-a46-ein1: 30.0 kPa lowest 0.017; 60.0 kPa lowest 0.016; 90.0 kPa lowest 0.014; 105.0 kPa lowest 0.012.
